name: Yazaki Hoshimi
source:
A first year student in a neighboring class. Her body is frail and when she walks outside she carries a parasol. She is shy and reserved, so if something happens, she immediately hides herself with the parasol. Her family owns a kendo dojo. In fact, she received training as a child, and now she is specialized in using her parasol for combat if a fight happens. She consulted the Big Sky club with her troubles, and after that she joined.

[Based on [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/初恋サクラメント]Wikipedia[/url]]
